title: Special Order for National Tank & Equipment, LLC, ex parte. — National Tank & Equipment, LLC, ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8167. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 8167 hereby is, cancelled.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                           SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 70-2026

                         NATIONAL TANK & EQUIPMENT, LLC
                                    EX PARTE

                       In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8167
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC No. 8167 per a notarized affidavit
received on November 12, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC No. 8167 held by National
Tank & Equipment, LLC is hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees
and fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.

                                 (Decided November 20, 2026)




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
November 17, 2026



                                                 DISTRICT I
                                                 CHAIRMAN ERIC F. SKRMETTA


                                                 DISTRICT II
                                                 VICE CHAIRMAN JEAN-PAUL P. COUSSAN


                                                 DISTRICT V
                                                 COMMISSIONER FOSTER L. CAMPBELL


                                                 DISTRICT IV
                                                 COMMISSIONER MIKE FRANCIS
